name: iTEL Community Telco
summary: Ipswich community-buying-group telco (Community Developments Australia/Bendigo Bank franchise); acquired GIL and Flexinet 2001; later South East Qld Community Telco, folded into Bendigo Bank Telco.

events.details: iTEL Community Telco Limited incorporated 3 Sep 2001.
ABN cancelled 24 Jul 2020 (brand under Bendigo Bank Telco).
